page_title: LUT 2-1 BOU | Luton v Bournemouth 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' Luton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 2 - 1 Goal! Carlton Morris (Luton) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the back of the net.
87' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Lewis Cook will be replaced by Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
86' Substitution. Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) replaces Milos Kerkez.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.

86' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bournemouth.
85' Ball possession – 56:44.
82' Luton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' Luton are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The ball goes out of play. Luton are awarded a corner kick.
80' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cauley Woodrow (Luton) replacing Tahith Chong.
80' Referee Andy Madley sees the trip by Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
75' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Andy Madley no option but to blow his whistle.
73' 1 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Jordan Clark (Luton) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
68' Substitution. Antoine Semenyo walks off the pitch and Enes Unal (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
68' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Justin Kluivert is replaced by Philip Billing (Bournemouth).
66' Daiki Hashioka will be replaced by Luke Berry (Luton).
63' Carlton Morris (Luton) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fred Onyedinma (Luton) is coming onto the pitch as Andros Townsend cannot continue after picking up an injury.
62' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. Luke Berry replaces Daiki Hashioka (Luton).
61' Teden Mengi (Luton) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
60' Andros Townsend (Luton) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Andy Madley stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
58' Problems for Andoni Iraola as Marcus Tavernier is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) replaces him.
56' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

55' Great solo effort from Ross Barkley (Luton)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.

52' 0 - 1 Goal! Justin Kluivert plays a long ball to Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 0:1.
51' Jordan Clark (Luton) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
50' Ross Barkley (Luton) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Neto tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
49' Andy Madley blows his whistle and signals a foul after Adam Smith (Bournemouth) brought his opponent down.
48' Daiki Hashioka (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but Neto comes off his line to gather the ball.
48' Good defending. Andros Townsend (Luton) tries to find Daiki Hashioka inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
47' A snap shot by Carlton Morris (Luton) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Neto produces a good save to thwart him.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Alfie Doughty (Luton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Ross Barkley (Luton) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
41' None of the Luton players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
41' Luton play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
40' Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul after Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) hacks down one of his opponents.
39' Bournemouth control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
37' Teden Mengi (Luton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' The resulting set piece from Luton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Luton. Luton force a corner. They send men into the box.
32' An attempted cross from Tahith Chong (Luton) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Luton can continue in their attacking effort.
31' Andy Madley blows his whistle as Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
30' Good movement by Issa Kabore (Luton), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
27' Andy Madley blows his whistle. Reece Burke (Luton) commits a foul after dangerous play.
25' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
25' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
25' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Bournemouth get a corner.
23' Teden Mengi (Luton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
21' Andros Townsend (Luton) sprays a pass out to Ross Barkley, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
19' The corner is swung in but Luton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
18' Luton keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. Luton force their opponents to concede a corner.

16' POST! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
14' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
13' Daiki Hashioka (Luton) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance!
10' Andy Madley blows his whistle after Ross Barkley (Luton) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
8' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
8' Tahith Chong (Luton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
7' Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
6' Luton are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. Now Luton have a corner.
5' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is penalised for holding. Andy Madley signals a set piece.

4' Ross Barkley (Luton) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
4' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) tries to find Marcus Tavernier, but he puts too much power on the pass.
3' The Luton players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Luton will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Andy Madley.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
